text.tspan: Fog of War: seven moves through White’s eyes

Each board is exactly what White sees after every move, White’s and Black’s. Fogged squares are ones no White piece could move to. When Black moves, White learns nothing unless something in view changes. Under each board, in blue, is where every piece really stood.
What actually happened: 1. e4 Nf6 2. Nc3 d6 3. Bb5 g6 4. Bxe8
